# `.specboot/bootstrap/` — Transient Adoption Payload

**This directory is temporary.** It exists only so an AI client can discover the SpecBoot adoption
contract in a repository that does not yet have SpecBoot installed.

It is git-ignored. It is **removed in full by `ADOPT-18`** once the permanent adoption is verified.

**Do not edit anything here and do not treat it as canonical.** Every file in this directory is a
copy assembled from a canonical source elsewhere. The durable record of what this payload created,
and what became of each entry, lives in `.specboot/adoption/BOOTSTRAP-MANIFEST.json`, which is
committed and survives cleanup.

Start by reading `SPECBOOT_ADOPTION_GUIDE.md` in this directory.
